errors.evidence: The entire description of this line's trend and values is incorrect. The line for "Oil and petroleum products" starts at approximately 94% (not 98%), is at approximately 94% in 2014 (not 96%), and ends at approximately 94% in 2018 (not 97%).

errors.evidence: The line for "Natural gas" does not rise to 75% in 2012. In 2012, its value is approximately 71%.
The color of the "Oil and petroleum products" line is more accurately described as teal or light blue-green, not dark green.
The value for "Solid fossil fuels" in 2009 drops to approximately 36%, not 38%.
